steps.headline: This is what done means for the buddy on Linux.

rows.statement: Switching the buddy on for the first time asks you before anything is added to your desktop.
rows.threshold: pass/fail — the ask happens once, at the switch, not during first-run setup

rows.statement: The popup explains what the helper does, says the buddy cannot be turned on without it, and does not promise removal on uninstall.
rows.threshold: pass/fail — the approved card, re-shot from the built branch
rows.note: AMENDED 2026-09-04. The approved card said 'it is removed when you uninstall YouCoded', which is false for most Linux users. Replacement wording carried in the design.

rows.statement: The choice you are given is Add helper or Not now.
rows.threshold: pass/fail — the approved card, re-shot from the built branch

rows.statement: If you decline the helper, no buddy appears at all — nothing stuck in one spot.
On a Linux desktop the helper cannot work on, the row reads Not yet supported on this desktop.
rows.threshold: pass/fail — the approved row, re-shot from the built branch

rows.statement: The separate switch for pinning the buddy above other windows is gone; the popup is one row.
rows.threshold: pass/fail — the approved row, re-shot from the built branch
rows.note: AMENDED 2026-09-04 by decide-uninstall#D-1: a Remove helper action is a second control. It appears ONLY when the helper is installed, so the one-row state this row was signed against is still what a new user sees. Acceptance re-shoots both states.

rows.statement: Whenever the buddy is on, it stays above other windows without you asking for it.
Once the helper is added, you can drag the buddy anywhere on screen and it stays there.
Turning the buddy off leaves the helper in place, so turning it back on is instant.
rows.threshold: pass/fail — no second question on the way back on

rows.statement: You can remove the helper again yourself, any time, from the buddy's own settings.
rows.threshold: pass/fail — Remove helper takes it out of KDE's settings and the buddy switches off
rows.note: AMENDED 2026-09-04. Was: 'Uninstalling the app takes the helper back out of your desktop settings' (source questions#Q-3). Design review found that unbuildable — AppImage, the first format shipped, has no uninstall step at all, and on deb/rpm/pacman the hook runs as root against a per-user kwinrc. Re-opened via the decide deck; Destin chose a user-owned Remove helper control plus honest wording.

rows.statement: An app update puts an improved helper in place quietly, without asking you again.
If your buddy is already on, it is hidden after the update until you turn it back on.
rows.note: hide the buddy at the start of next update/ then prompt only if user goes in to re enable/

rows.statement: The offer to add the helper waits in the buddy's settings; no dialog interrupts you after an update.
